Package org.Jtech.Controller

Class AuthController

java.lang.Object
org.Jtech.Controller.AuthController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/v1/auth") public class AuthController extends Object
Authentication Controller Purpose: Exposes REST APIs for user authentication and account security, including login, signup, password reset, and OTP-based verification. Scope: - User login with JWT token generation - User registration - Password reset workflows - Email and OTP verification Metadata: Added on : 2025-12-29 Author : Mohit Singh Notes: This controller is responsible only for authentication and account security operations. User profile and product-related logic are handled by separate controllers.

      @PostMapping("signup") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> registerUser(@RequestBody UserAndDetails userAndDetails)
